notes: Fourth Round prospective obligation = 450 units; settled after mediation March 28, 2025; court order May 5, 2025. DCA had 503 — HEFSP uses 450 per court order. Present Need = 51 (DCA; accepted). 4th Round RDP = 24 units from 3 changed-circumstance sites. Third Round: 736 total obligation (54 RDP + 682 unmet), all completed. Candidate snapshot had 4 sites (R-5B, R-5C, R-5E, R-5F) — R-5B/E/F are third round unmet need mechanisms; actual 4th Round RDP sites are only 3 (Ramsey Housing, Constantine Drive, 425 Island Road). Candidate prospective obligation 450 correct (matches court order).
